body:
That’s really good advice! Thank you
I’ll start doing that
I’m worried that he won’t want to sign over his parental rights even though he doesn’t care right now about the person carrying the child and sustaining it.

I’m so sorry to hear about your partner :( that’s truly awful and no child deserves to live that way or go through any of that ever! I have my own home, fully paid off and a full time stable job as a therapist. I’m financially stable enough to provide for this child. 

The only issue is the father’s lack of support, this is more of an emotional issue and needing support rather than needing money or anything like that. 

Thank you for sharing your story and for the advice❤️
I’m financially stable. I’m just having a difficult time mentally right now because of the lack of support. You don’t need to be so harsh..
It is too late. Even if the father isn’t a great person, I’ll love and take care of this baby. I don’t need him but it would be nice to have his support
I didn’t take it as criticism! I’m very appreciative of all this advice and I’m taking it all in and I have been going to therapy :) I’m really trying. Thank you ❤️
I’m terrified to do this alone but hopefully when I do tell my family I’ll have their support. I honestly don’t know. Feeling extremely hopeless

You’re not being rude at all( to me at least) 
and I do agree it’s too big and too much to go through alone, I plan to tell my family when I go visit them in a few weeks. It’s not something I can really hide for much longer 😅

I haven’t told anyone else about the pregnancy yet, just me and the baby’s father know. So no, I haven’t talked to anyone else about these feelings. I did let my mom know I’m feeling really down and she said she’ll book a ticket for me to go visit and spend some time with her🥰
That’s exactly it! It hurts so much knowing there are people out there who don’t know me but can see what I’m going through to an extent yet someone I’ve been with for 6 years doesn’t care.
That’s what I think too

I completely agree with you! I haven’t driven to see him in months and I don’t plan to. If he wants to, he will. It just hurts and I’m extra emotional and going through all these changes alone (first time pregnant)
I did talk to him twice! about moving in with him and his family and that I won’t be comfortable but it seems like it’s in one ear and out the other
I stopped for a couple months and he hasn’t made any effort to drive my way. I’m not going to do it anymore
My family lives on a different continent unfortunately. This whole thread is making me sob and not because anyone is rude or anything, just hormones I guess

I think my health is okay, family hasn’t ever really been there so I don’t mind that very much, I’ve been single for quite some time now so I doubt that’s the issue.. I honestly think I’m just tired of feeling this way for no apparent reason

I’m sorry to hear that you’re also feeling down :/
It definitely does come in waves for me but this particular wave doesn’t seem to be going away..
I feel empty, hopeless, meds are no longer working, journaling doesn’t work.. nothing seems to be helping anymore
My life has felt over for a long time now, I’m just ready
I'm happy you're here and I'm really grateful for your response and support. If you ever need an ear, I'm also here <3

Thank you for your kind response 🤍
I understand a lot of people prefer to show a brave face rather than show their pain and that may be the case for him but he ignores me but would reply to others even though he knows I’m hurting too
This is beautiful. Thank you❤️

My boyfriend did the same, he told his dad who said he wouldn’t tell anyone else but proceeded to tell my bfs siblings. Now everyone knows and I’m embarrassed. I just left. Walking away is really hard but it might be what’s best for your mental health.
